intro.en: Halogen-free cable specifications separate composition, gas acidity, smoke and flame performance.
intro.zh: 无卤电缆规格分别定义组成、气体酸度、烟密度与阻燃性能。

knowledge.en: One LSZH label does not prove every material and fire property.
knowledge.zh: 一个 LSZH 标签不能证明所有材料与火灾性能。

notes.en: Provide exact test methods, limits, cable construction and traceability.
notes.zh: 请提供准确试验方法、限值、线缆结构与追溯。

delivery.en: Release records the exact material construction and supporting reports.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含准确材料结构与支持报告。

subtitle.en: Separate material composition, gas acidity, smoke and flame performance
subtitle.zh: 分别定义材料组成、气体酸度、烟密度与阻燃性能

lead.zh: 逐项规定每一个所需性能。
